mapper.select: SELECT result_id AS id, student_id AS studentId, plan_id AS planId, total_earned_credits AS totalEarnedCredits, required_earned_credits AS requiredEarnedCredits, major_elective_earned_credits AS majorElectiveEarnedCredits, general_elective_earned_credits AS generalElectiveEarnedCredits, passed, missing_items AS missingItems, review_time AS reviewTime, gmt_create AS gmtCreate FROM edu_graduation_result WHERE student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY review_time DESC
